name: Kunj Shah Portfolio Agent
description: Read-only agent over kunjshah.in: answers questions about Kunj Shah's shipped AI systems, services and rates, open-source contributions, and writing, and can return any public page as Markdown. Every answer links to a page a human can open.

skills.name: Profile and availability
skills.description: Who Kunj Shah is, where he is based, what he builds, and whether he is available for work.
examples: Is Kunj Shah available for freelance AI work in India?

skills.name: Shipped AI systems
skills.description: Case studies for shipped projects with architecture, measured results, limitations, and how each system was tested.
examples: Which AI agents has Kunj Shah shipped?
What RAG systems has he built and how were they evaluated?

skills.name: Services and pricing
skills.description: Engagement types with fixed-scope pricing in INR, hourly review rates, retainers, and delivery timelines.
examples: How much does it cost to hire Kunj Shah to build an AI agent?
What are his hourly and retainer rates?

skills.name: Open-source contributions
skills.description: Merged pull requests into projects he does not own, including the OWASP agent-security harness and Microsoft AI-Engineering-Coach.
examples: What has Kunj Shah contributed to OWASP?
How many pull requests has he had merged upstream?

skills.name: Essays and technical writing
skills.description: Full-text essays on agent architecture, retrieval, evaluation, inference cost, and edge machine learning.
examples: What has Kunj Shah written about cutting LLM inference cost?
Explain Kunj Shah's argument about citations in research agents.
